#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
RUN_LOG="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/genos-chat-status-r1-XXXXXXXX.log")"
exec > >(tee -a "$RUN_LOG") 2>&1
trap 'result=$?; printf "FINISHED status=%s log=%s\n" "$result" "$RUN_LOG"' EXIT
printf 'START patch=chat-status-20260928-r1 log=%s\n' "$RUN_LOG"
DEPLOY_ROOT="${DEPLOY_ROOT:-$HOME/DEV}"
MODE="${MODE:-apply}"
[[ -d "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.git" || -f "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.git" ]] || { printf 'ERROR: existing Git checkout required\n'; exit 2; }
if [[ -z "${PYTHON_BIN:-}" ]]; then
    if [[ -x "$DEPLOY_ROOT/.venv/bin/python" ]]; then PYTHON_BIN="$DEPLOY_ROOT/.venv/bin/python";
    else PYTHON_BIN="$(command -v python3)"; fi
fi
mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_ROOT/TRANSFER"
PATCH_DIR="$(mktemp -d "$DEPLOY_ROOT/TRANSFER/chat-status-r1-unpack-XXXXXXXX")"
base64 -d > "$PATCH_DIR/package.zip" <<'PACKAGE_BASE64'

PACKAGE_BASE64
"$PYTHON_BIN" - "$PATCH_DIR/package.zip" "$PATCH_DIR" <<'PYUNPACK'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,zipfile
archive=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);target=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="78a177994350a0f03e00259e0c8d910eb4bfa3a1a952fbb778d83d3cb8a31691", 'ZIP hash mismatch'
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    names=z.namelist();assert len(names)==len(set(names))
    rows=json.loads(z.read('CODE_MANIFEST.json'))['files']
    assert set(names)=={x['path'] for x in rows}|{'CODE_MANIFEST.json'}
    for row in rows:
        path=pathlib.PurePosixPath(row['path']);assert not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts and '\\' not in row['path']
        raw=z.read(row['path']);assert len(raw)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
    z.extractall(target)
PYUNPACK
printf 'MODE=%s CHECKOUT=%s PYTHON=%s PACKAGE=%s\n' "$MODE" "$DEPLOY_ROOT" "$PYTHON_BIN" "$PATCH_DIR"
case "$MODE" in
    apply) "$PYTHON_BIN" "$PATCH_DIR/apply.py" --deploy-root "$DEPLOY_ROOT" ;;
    check) "$PYTHON_BIN" "$PATCH_DIR/apply.py" --deploy-root "$DEPLOY_ROOT" --check ;;
    rollback) : "${ROLLBACK_FROM:?Set ROLLBACK_FROM to the BACKUP_READY path}"; "$PYTHON_BIN" "$PATCH_DIR/apply.py" --deploy-root "$DEPLOY_ROOT" --rollback-from "$ROLLBACK_FROM" ;;
    *) printf 'ERROR: MODE must be apply, check, or rollback\n'; exit 2 ;;
esac
